text_block_list.text:
"My body isn't very strong."
That's what Manhattan Cafe had said, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Today...my body feels so heavy...

Some days are just like that.
When I told her, "Let's not push it and take a rest"...
(Scritch, scratch...)

The anomaly appeared in the sand. Wherever Manhattan
Cafe had walked, it left tracks looking as though
something heavy had been dragged along...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This weight is... I've never seen numbers like this before... What on earth happened...?

The weight gain was far beyond any naturally occurring range.
Furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Today... my body feels like paper...As if every inch of me has dried up...
(Clang, crack!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tsuu...!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My toe... nail... is...

Hurriedly taking off her shoe...
I found a crack in her dry hoof,
forming a small hole.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Weight... It feels remarkably light today...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I simply have no strength left...
This dryness must surely be why my hooves are cracking, too...
choice_data_list: Let's file down the tips and disinfect them.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh... There was... a way like that?
Using specialized medicine and reinforcement materials, I secure the hoof. It doesn't seem bad enough to warrant skipping training or races, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... you're amazing...
Taking such good care of me made it feel so much better...

Still, what could be the reason behind this sudden weight fluctuation?
I decided to ask a few questions.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
An appetite... There are certainly times when it surges uncontrollably.
Almost as if it has become bottomless...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I eat, I never feel full...
That's why I just keep eating without any emotion...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"On the flip side, there are times when I can't eat anything at all.
Even when I try to force food to my mouth, my hand just freezes up..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That wasn't... by my own will...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I do not understand.
Whether it's poor health habits or a paranormal phenomenon, I can't tell just from hearing about it. But for now—
choice_data_list: If anything strange happens to your body again, send me a photo

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Photos... All right...
I'll send them, but...
A few days later, Manhattan Cafe sent over a photo. And in it was—

I had no idea what was photographed;
all that showed up was a bizarre pattern.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's just what happens.
That's why I couldn't send photos of the affected area...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's... been like this since I was little, so there's probably nothing to be done...
My body will likely... stay this way forever...
choice_data_list: As long as you let me know, it's totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Contact you...? Anytime, really?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll treat you right away!
Yeah, I'll treat it right away!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...-san...
Thank... you so much...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If you can help me whenever something happens...
Even if I have to fudge it a bit, I'm sure I'll manage somehow...
After that, by mobilizing all our knowledge and making thorough preparations, Manhattan Cafe was somehow able to get through it, but...

It went far beyond merely "not having a strong body."
Her frailty and abnormality were... practically supernatural.
